### Cucumber Seed (G4)

A pale lime-green **Earth-pony colt** with a purple mane and tail, blue eyes, and a **two-pinecone cutie mark**. He is one of the youngsters at the Cutie Mark Crusaders’ Cutie Mark Day Camp; his memorable activity is **charming a snake**.

**Names:** *Cucumber Seed* is a fan/wiki placeholder name, not a verified spoken show name. The licensed Gameloft game *My Little Pony: Magic Princess* identifies him as **Snake-Charming Colt**, showing him with a tall plumed headdress. That is a game designation, not a secret identity. The specific origin of the fandom name is unverified.

**Appearances:** *Friendship Is Magic* S7E21, **“Marks and Recreation,”** and S9E12, **“The Last Crusade.”** No individually identifiable spoken lines or credited voice actor were verified. [Foal-character reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Foals).
